# Benjamin McKenzie — Company Formation Insights

## Site Information
- Site: https://benjaminmckenzie.com
- Language: English
- Type: Blog with expert insights on Hong Kong company formation
- Last Updated: 2026-08-11

## About the Author
Benjamin McKenzie is a Startup Mentor based in Hong Kong who helps foreign entrepreneurs navigate company formation, compliance, and business setup in Asia. He studied at the University of Cambridge and has over a decade of experience in venture capital and private equity in Hong Kong.

- [Hong Kong IP Tax Deduction Bill and 2025/26 Return Deadlines](https://benjaminmckenzie.com/articles/hong-kong-ip-tax-deduction-bill-and-return-deadlines) — The IP expenditure deduction Bill gazetted 16 October 2026, the real 2025/26 return deadlines from the March block extension circular, and six new double taxation agreements.
- [Hong Kong Business Registration and Tax Filing for Founders](https://benjaminmckenzie.com/articles/hong-kong-business-registration-and-tax-filing) — What the business registration certificate does and does not prove, what it costs, and the tax, payroll and MPF filings that follow.
- [How Expats Use Hong Kong Government Funding: The HKSTP and ITF Guide](https://benjaminmckenzie.com/articles/hong-kong-hkstp-funding-for-expats-guide) — Expat founder guide to HKSTP and ITF funding: company first, scheme selection, a Hong Kong Island working base, and the taxable treatment of government subsidies under IRO section 15(1)(c).
- [Hong Kong Salaries Tax for Founders](https://benjaminmckenzie.com/articles/hong-kong-salaries-tax-founder-guide) — Source-led guide to Salaries Tax reporting, 2026/27 allowances, deductions, progressive vs two-tier standard-rate and eTAX ITP filing.
- [How to Register a Hong Kong Company in 2026](https://benjaminmckenzie.com/articles/hong-kong-company-registration-2026) — Complete guide covering registration process, requirements, timelines, and costs.
- [Limited Company vs Sole Proprietorship: Which Should You Choose?](https://benjaminmckenzie.com/articles/llc-vs-corporation-which-business-structure) — Compare structures, benefits, costs, and tax implications.
- [How Much Does It Cost to Start a Business in Hong Kong?](https://benjaminmckenzie.com/articles/how-much-does-it-cost-to-start-business-hong-kong) — Detailed breakdown of startup costs including government fees and annual maintenance.
- [How to Open a Hong Kong Bank Account as a Foreigner](https://benjaminmckenzie.com/articles/how-to-open-hong-kong-bank-account-foreigner) — Step-by-step guide for non-residents to open bank accounts in Hong Kong.
- [Hong Kong Company Annual Compliance: What You Need to Know](https://benjaminmckenzie.com/articles/hong-kong-company-annual-compliance) — Essential compliance requirements including Annual Returns, audits, and Profits Tax.
- [Offshore Company vs Onshore Company: Key Differences](https://benjaminmckenzie.com/articles/offshore-vs-onshore-company-differences) — Tax implications, compliance requirements, and which structure suits your business.
- [Osome vs Sleek vs Statrys: HK Company Formation Compared](https://benjaminmckenzie.com/articles/osome-vs-sleek-vs-statrys-comparison) — Platform comparison for pricing, features, and ease of use.

- [Hong Kong Corporate Bank Account Approval Times](https://benjaminmckenzie.com/articles/anonymised-bank-account-approval-times-non-residents) — Anonymised dataset of 805 corporate bank account application attempts, with approval rates, processing times, methodology and the limits of what the data can show.
- [GetStarted.hk vs Osome: Hong Kong Services Compared](https://benjaminmckenzie.com/articles/getstarted-hk-vs-osome-comparison) — Published company formation, compliance, accounting, tax and banking scope compared side by side, with a founder-fit framework and what to verify before buying.
- [Hong Kong Bank Account Approval Times: Anonymised Case Study](https://benjaminmckenzie.com/articles/hong-kong-bank-account-approval-times-anonymised-case-study) — How long corporate account applications actually take in the anonymised record, and what the underlying data cannot tell you about your own application.
- [Hong Kong Company Formation Services: 7 Providers Compared](https://benjaminmckenzie.com/articles/hong-kong-company-formation-services-7-providers) — Seven formation providers compared by published pricing, service scope, TCSP licensing status and which founder situation each one actually fits.
- [International Business Planning: UK, Thailand and Hong Kong](https://benjaminmckenzie.com/articles/international-business-planning-uk-thailand-hong-kong) — How retirement planning, company incorporation and tax residency interact when your life and your business are in different countries.
